sentences.text: The Scheme for Assistance to Scheduled Tribes for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (SASSTAP) aims to enhance the skills and entrepreneurship capabilities of Scheduled Tribe communities in India.
The objective of SASSTAP is to promote skill development and self-employment among Scheduled Tribe individuals.
The scheme provides financial assistance for skill development training programs.
It also supports the establishment of self-employment ventures for Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries.
Eligibility is primarily limited to individuals belonging to Scheduled Tribe communities.
The application process involves submitting a proposal to the concerned implementing authority.
The timeline for the implementation of training programs and disbursement of funds varies based on the specific project.
The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the primary implementing authority for this scheme.
Additional details regarding specific training programs and funding limits may vary based on state and local requirements.
